name: Digital Research Methods using AI
description: Introduction to Digital Business Research - Researching for business, Business vs marketing research, Research process, Role of GenAI in research; Digital tools and prompt engineering - Using digital technologies for research, Maintaining scientific rigor, Tools landscape, Appropriateness for the research objectives, and Prompt engineering; Research Design, and Ethics - Theory, Constructs and items; Digital research ethics, and Privacy, consent, AI hallucinations; Sampling - Probability vs non-probability sampling, Online panels, LinkedIn/community sampling, and Bias in digital sampling; Secondary Data & Digital Intelligence - Secondary research, Web analytics sources, Competitor intelligence, and Search trend analysis; Questionnaires & Scale Development - Likert scale, Reliability & validity, AI-generated scale items, and Scale refinement; Qualitative Research - Online interviews, Virtual focus groups, Live events analysis; Observation Studies & Netnography - Digital observation, Customer journey observation, Netnography, Social media observation; Online Surveys - Survey design, Mobile-first questionnaires, Attention checks, Survey logic; Digital Experiments & A/B Testing - Classical and Quasi., Online controlled experiments; Quantitative Data Analysis - Approaches to quantitative data analysis, Data preparation, Basic statistics, Interpreting for business decisions; Qualitative Data Analysis - Thematic coding, Text analytics, Sentiment analysis, AI-assisted interpretation; Report Writing & Storytelling - Executive reports, Dashboards, Insight storytelling, AI-generated presentations; Guest lectures from academic experts and industry professionals.
